newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish December reserve money on c.bank target.
newsitem.headline: Polish December reserve money on c.bank target.

text.p: The daily average level of Polish reserve money in December was 34.964 billion zlotys, within the National Bank of Poland's target band of 34.43 to 35.13 billion zlotys, the central bank said in a statement on Tuesday.
The average level of reserve money in November was 33.54 billion zlotys, within the target of 33.29 to 33.99 billion.
Reserve money, also called high powered money or monetary base, consisits of cash in circulation, cash in vaults and obligatory reserves.
Since January 1996, it has served as the central banks' monetary policy operational target, through which it wants to control money supply growth and inflation.
